{"claims":[{"claim_text":"We fight the Constitution to win a democratic socialist republic in North America.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The goal is to complete the partial overthrow of the constitutional order by the Civil War and the abolition of slavery.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The goal is to finish the project of Reconstruction by establishing a multiracial and multinational democracy ruled by the toilers of society.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Forged in revolution, this continental republic will strive for the global liberation of all working and oppressed people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We desire the widest possible geographic scope for a state so that it can most effectively carry out its mission.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We recognize the principle of national self-determination.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All indigenous and colonized peoples must win sovereignty, including those living within the current borders of the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"No oppressed nation will be incorporated into the socialist republic against its will.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The minoritarian and sclerotic constitutional order will contribute to massive political crises in the coming decades.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"This period of crisis will provide our class with an opportunity to topple the old order and convene a revolutionary Popular Assembly.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A revolutionary Popular Assembly will be a majoritarian constitutional convention elected by all the people.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Under the democratic leadership of a victorious socialist party, the Popular Assembly will proceed to construct the socialist order.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Popular Assembly will dismantle the slaveholder constitution.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Popular Assembly will write the founding documents of the new republic.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
